heroicmap.angebot.keins: This server offers no map to download.
heroicmap.angebot.unlesbar: The server's offer cannot be read.
heroicmap.befehl.unbekannt: The map %s is not offered here.
heroicmap.befehl.massstab: No such scale; 1, 2 or 4 pixels per block.
heroicmap.befehl.massstab_fehlt: The server does not offer this scale for the map: %s px.
heroicmap.befehl.kein_satz: Nothing of the map %s is on disk yet; use /hmap laden first.
heroicmap.befehl.frage: %s: up to %s at %s pixels per block. A full download counts against the server's limit, 5 per week by default; saying no costs nothing.
heroicmap.befehl.frage_wechsel: %s: up to %s at %s pixels per block. A full download counts against the server's limit, 5 per week by default; saying no costs nothing. Your map at %s px is removed once the new one is complete.
heroicmap.download.titel: Download the map from the server?
heroicmap.download.frage: The game server %s offers the map from %s. It needs up to %s on disk, at %s pixels per block. The mod downloads data from this host.
heroicmap.download.host: The game server %s has the map downloaded from %s. The mod downloads data from this host.
heroicmap.download.fertig: Map downloaded: %s new, %s already there, %s removed, %s.
heroicmap.download.gekappt: Map partly downloaded: %s new, %s already there, %s removed, %s. The rest comes with the next sync or a full download.
heroicmap.download.belegt: A download for the map %s is already waiting or running.
heroicmap.download.verfaellt_belegt: A download for the map %s is already waiting or running; the new release lapses.
heroicmap.download.verfaellt_dialog: A dialog is already open; the release for %s lapses.
heroicmap.download.nicht_angeboten: The server releases a map it does not offer: %s.
heroicmap.download.abgelehnt_wieder: The server declines: %s Possible again from %s.
heroicmap.download.unlesbar: The server's release cannot be read.
heroicmap.download.grund.pruefsumme: The manifest does not match the release.
heroicmap.download.grund.manifest: Manifest or map.json break a limit.
heroicmap.download.grund.abgelehnt: The map server declines the token.
heroicmap.download.grund.budget: This download's budget is used up; the rest comes with the next sync.
heroicmap.download.grund.netz: No, an incomplete or a wrong answer from the map server.
heroicmap.download.grund.heimnetz: The map is in a private network and not on the game server itself; the mod downloads nothing.
heroicmap.download.grund.unbekannt: The map's host does not exist.
heroicmap.download.grund.anderer: An error in the mod; details in the log.
heroicmap.karte.keine: No map is downloaded for this dimension; /hmap angebot shows what the server offers.
heroicmap.download.abgleich_ab: The next sync is possible from %s.
heroicmap.menue.ziehen: Drag to move the minimap, drag the handle to resize it.
heroicmap.menue.show.grund.permission: The server does not allow you other players on the map.
heroicmap.menue.show.grund.simplevoicech: Simple Voice Chat is missing on the server.
heroicmap.menue.show.grund.sonst: The server declines other players on the map.
heroicmap.liste.frage: %s with %s will be removed from disk. You only get it back with a new download.
heroicmap.liste.belegt: A download into this map is running.
heroicmap.liste.fehler: The map was not fully deleted; see the log for details.
heroicmap.selbst.frage: From now on the mod draws every chunk you load in this dimension at 4 pixels per block into a map of its own for this world. The full map then shows only that map, not the server's. To stop: delete it in the map list.
heroicmap.selbst.gewaehlt: The mod now draws the map itself.
heroicmap.selbst.geht_nicht: Drawing it yourself only works on a server and not under a ceiling.
heroicmap.selbst.fehler: The map to draw yourself could not be created; see the log for details.
heroicmap.befehl.welt_unbekannt: Enter %s first; only then does the mod know which world the map belongs to.
heroicmap.liste.frage_selbst: %s with %s will be removed from disk. Your own map starts over once you choose “Myself” again.
